head: ʕyṭ (< Arab. ʕyṭ (II) cf. Wehr 902: laut schreien; 486;)

senses.gloss: durch Anschreien verscheuchen (Tier); (Ilyas knows the verb as used mostly about humans, not animals); scream, yell (as a feedback to something wrongly done)

stems.sensesRaw: durch Anschreien verscheuchen (Tier); (Ilyas knows the verb as used mostly about humans, not animals); scream, yell (as a feedback to something wrongly done)

examples.turoyo: lu+muxtār mʕaṭle ʕal u+ruʕyo dlo mičək ba+zyone; mʕaṭli ʕal i+barṯayḏi dlo mṣammo u+bayto
